note: Where to cancel common US subscriptions. Hand-curated and best effort: services move these pages, and the merchant's own page is authoritative. Platforms (Apple, Google, PayPal, Amazon) bill for other services; a charge through one is cancelled there. `match` lists words that appear in bank descriptors (lower case; '+' reads as 'plus', other punctuation as a space).

entries.name: Apple
steps: Apple bills for iCloud+, Apple One, Apple Music, Apple TV+, and every subscription bought in an iPhone or iPad app.
On an iPhone: Settings → your name → Subscriptions, then pick the subscription and tap Cancel Subscription.
On the web: sign in at the link above with your Apple Account and choose Cancel next to the subscription.

entries.name: Google
steps: Google bills for Google One, YouTube Premium, Google Play apps, and other Google services.
Open Payments & subscriptions, choose Manage subscriptions, pick the subscription, and cancel it.
Subscriptions bought in an Android app are under Google Play subscriptions.

entries.name: PayPal
steps: A charge through PayPal is an automatic payment you approved for a merchant.
Open Automatic payments, choose the merchant, and select Cancel. This stops PayPal paying them; cancel with the merchant too if you have an account there.

entries.name: Amazon
steps: Amazon bills for Prime, Prime Video channels, Kindle Unlimited, Amazon Music, and other subscriptions.
Open Memberships & Subscriptions and choose Cancel subscription next to the one you want to stop.
For Prime itself, open the Prime membership page and choose End membership.

entries.name: Netflix
steps: Sign in to the Netflix account that is billed.
Choose Cancel Membership, then Finish Cancellation.

entries.name: Spotify
steps: Sign in, open Manage your plan, and choose Cancel subscription.

entries.name: Hulu
steps: Sign in to your Hulu account page and choose Cancel under Your Subscription.

entries.name: Disney+
steps: Sign in, open Account, choose your subscription, and select Cancel Subscription.

entries.name: HBO Max
steps: Sign in, open your profile → Settings → Subscription, and choose Cancel Your Subscription.

entries.name: Paramount+
steps: Sign in, open Account, and choose Cancel Subscription.

entries.name: Peacock
steps: Sign in, open Account → Plans & Payment, and choose Change Plan → Cancel Plan.

entries.name: YouTube Premium / YouTube TV
steps: Open Paid memberships, choose the membership, and select Deactivate or Cancel membership.

entries.name: Audible
steps: Sign in on the Audible website (the app cannot cancel), open Account Details, and choose Cancel membership.

entries.name: Microsoft (365, Xbox Game Pass)
steps: Sign in, open Subscriptions, choose Manage on the subscription, and select Cancel subscription.

entries.name: Adobe
steps: Sign in, open Plans, choose Manage plan, and select Cancel your plan.
Annual plans paid monthly can carry an early termination fee; Adobe shows it before you confirm.

entries.name: Dropbox
steps: Sign in on the Dropbox website, open Settings → Plan, and choose Cancel plan.

entries.name: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
steps: Sign in, open your profile → Settings → Account, choose Manage next to your plan, and select Cancel plan.

entries.name: Claude (Anthropic)
steps: Sign in, open Settings → Billing, and choose Cancel next to your plan.

entries.name: GitHub
steps: Sign in, open Settings → Billing and licensing, and downgrade or cancel the plan or Copilot subscription.

entries.name: Planet Fitness
steps: Many clubs cancel only in person at your home club or by a signed letter mailed to it; your membership agreement says which.
Some clubs allow cancelling online from the account page. Keep the confirmation.

entries.name: Peloton
steps: Sign in on the Peloton website, open Preferences → Subscriptions, choose the membership, and cancel it.

entries.name: Duolingo
steps: If you subscribed in the iPhone or Android app, cancel through Apple or Google instead.
Otherwise sign in on the website, open Settings → Subscription, and choose Cancel.

entries.name: The New York Times
steps: Sign in to My Account, open the subscription, and choose Cancel subscription (some plans route you to chat).

entries.name: The Wall Street Journal
steps: Sign in to the Customer Center and look for Cancel subscription; some plans can only be cancelled by chat or phone.

entries.name: The Washington Post
steps: Sign in, open your account → Subscription, and choose Cancel subscription.

entries.name: SiriusXM
steps: Sign in to your SiriusXM account; cancelling usually goes through online chat or a call to customer care, which will offer discounts first.

entries.name: Xfinity (Comcast)
steps: Sign in to My Account. Cancelling service is done by chat, phone, or at a store, and equipment has to be returned.

entries.name: Verizon
steps: Sign in to My Verizon. Ending a line or service usually needs a call or a store visit; porting your number to another carrier also closes it.

entries.name: AT&T
steps: Sign in to your AT&T account. Cancelling service is done by phone or chat; porting your number to another carrier also closes a wireless line.

entries.name: T-Mobile
steps: Sign in to your T-Mobile account. Cancelling service is done by phone, chat, or at a store.

entries.name: DoorDash (DashPass)
steps: Sign in, open Account → DashPass (or Manage DashPass), and choose End subscription.

entries.name: Uber One
steps: In the Uber app, open Account → Uber One → Manage membership, and choose End membership.

entries.name: Instacart+
steps: Sign in, open Your account → Instacart+ membership, and choose End membership.

entries.name: Walmart+
steps: Sign in, open Walmart+ → Manage membership, and choose Cancel membership.

entries.name: Costco membership
steps: Costco memberships are cancelled at a warehouse membership counter or through member services by phone; ask about a refund of the fee.

entries.name: Patreon
steps: Open Memberships, choose the creator, and select Edit → Cancel membership. Patreon memberships bought in the iPhone app are cancelled through Apple.

entries.name: PlayStation Plus
steps: Sign in to your account management page, open Subscriptions Management, and turn off auto-renew.

entries.name: Nintendo Switch Online
steps: Sign in to your Nintendo Account, open Shop Menu → Subscriptions, and turn off automatic renewal.

entries.name: HelloFresh
steps: Sign in, open Account settings → Plan settings, and choose Cancel plan before the weekly cutoff for your next box.

entries.name: Canva
steps: Sign in, open Settings → Billing & plans, and choose Cancel subscription.

entries.name: 1Password
steps: Sign in on 1Password.com, open Billing, and choose Cancel subscription (export your data first if you are leaving).

entries.name: Grammarly
steps: Sign in, open Subscription, and choose Cancel subscription.

entries.name: Zoom
steps: Sign in, open Billing → Current plans, and choose Cancel subscription.

entries.name: LinkedIn Premium
steps: Sign in, open Me → Premium features (or Settings → Account preferences → Subscriptions), and choose Cancel subscription.

entries.name: Crunchyroll
steps: Sign in, open Membership Info, and choose Cancel Membership.

entries.name: Starz
steps: Sign in, open Settings → Account, and choose Cancel subscription.

entries.name: Ring Protect
steps: Sign in to your Ring account, open Plans, and choose Cancel Plan.

entries.name: NordVPN
steps: Sign in to Nord Account, open Billing → Subscriptions, and turn off auto-renewal.

entries.name: Ancestry
steps: Sign in, open Account settings → Membership, and choose Cancel subscription.

entries.name: Squarespace
steps: Sign in, open the site's Settings → Billing, and cancel the plan (domains renew separately; turn off auto-renew too).

entries.name: GoDaddy
steps: Sign in, open My Products, and turn off auto-renew (or cancel) for each product you no longer want.

entries.name: Namecheap
steps: Sign in, open Domain List (or the product list), and turn off Auto-Renew for what you no longer want.
